newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Quake jolts Indonesia's Aceh, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts Indonesia's Aceh, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.4 on the Richter scale jolted Indonesia's westernmost province of Aceh on Thursday but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties, Antara news agency reported.
It quoted meteorology officials as saying the earthquake, with its epicentre located in the Kutacane area, 1,450 km (900 miles) northwest of Jakarta, struck at 7.32 a.m. (0032 GMT).
The officials said residents in the provincial capital Banda Aceh, 350 km (217 miles) northwest of the epicentre, felt the tremor, but added there were no reports of damage or casualties.
